options.summary: Requalify as a comparison on the metric the arc does record, 6 of 6 on false-or-stale specifics
options.rationale: Accurate on both counts and keeps the arc's series comparable, at the cost of a longer clause.

options.summary: Retain the superlative explicitly marked as belief

escalations.answer: Drop the superlative, keep the measured figure. The orchestrator corrected measurement.md directly and amended manifest.json criterion 9 as A2; T5 strikes the clause from the :344 cell in revision round 2.
